name: Turks and Caicos Islands
headline: Turks and Caicos Islands: +5.6% growth in 2024
sections: Turks and Caicos Islands is a $1.7 billion economy (2024), the world's 196th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +5.6% in 2024, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $38K at purchasing-power parity (2024), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 0.4% of GDP (2024).
